drill.title: Java 25 Drill
drill.intro: Concept questions and full mock exams for Oracle Certified Professional: Java SE 25 Developer (1Z0-831). The concept sets have no code, so you can do them by voice or with the car's buttons. The mock exams are code-based like the real one: read and tap, with several “choose two” questions.
drill.examsText: Two sets of 25 spoken-friendly concept questions with feedback. Then two mock exams like the real one: 50 code questions, 120 minutes, pass mark 34 (68%). Every code question was compiled and run with JDK 25. Mock exams are touch only.

lessons.title: Java 25 Audio
lessons.eyebrow: Oracle Certified Professional · Java SE 25 Developer · 1Z0-831
lessons.sub: 13 episodes · 12 lessons and a recap podcast · every rule, no code to read · quizzes with a pause so you can answer aloud
lessons.drillSub: 50 concept questions by voice or car buttons, and two 50-question mock exams

episodes.t: The exam and the Java 25 landscape
episodes.s: Format, pass mark, what changed from 17 to 25, the four Java 25 finals, how to study
Promotion, overflow, compound assignment, wrappers and caching, String and StringBuilder, text blocks
java.time classes, Period vs Duration, daylight saving gaps, formatter patterns
Switch expressions, yield, exhaustiveness, instanceof and switch patterns, guards, record patterns, unnamed _
Initialization order, flexible constructor bodies, overloading, overriding, hiding, default methods

episodes.t: Records, sealed types, enums, nested classes
episodes.s: Compact constructors, permits, enum bodies, inner classes, compact source files and instance main
Checked vs unchecked, catch rules, multi-catch, finally, try-with-resources, suppressed exceptions
Arrays helpers, List/Set/Map/Deque, unmodifiable collections, sequenced collections, wildcards
Functional interfaces, method references, laziness, collectors, Optional, gatherers, parallel
Executors, futures, locks, atomics, concurrent collections, virtual threads, scoped values
Imports and module imports, module-info directives, services, javac/java/jar/jdeps/jlink
Readers and streams, Path and Files, serialization, Locale, number formats, resource bundles
Two hosts, the most common traps topic by topic, and a rapid-fire round

say.intro: Java 25 concept drill. After each question, say number one, two, three, or four, or words from the answer. Say repeat to hear the question again.
say.intro_buttons: Java 25 concept drill, with car buttons. I will read each option. Press next when you hear the one you want. Press previous to hear the question again.
say.exam_intro: Java 25 mock exam. No feedback until the end. Answer each question by saying number one to four, or words from the answer.
say.exam_intro_buttons: Java 25 mock exam. No feedback until the end. I will read each option. Press next on the one you want, then next again to confirm.
say.exam_pass: That is a pass. The pass mark is sixty-eight percent.
say.exam_fail: That is below the pass mark of sixty-eight percent. Review the missed questions.
